title: Sri Lankan-Style Vegan Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir-fry made with a variety of vegetables and a hint of Sri Lankan spices, all vegan and ready in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Sri Lankan curry powder and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the quick-cooking rice noodles and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until they're well coated with the curry powder and starting to brown.
Add the sliced almonds and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce and lime juice, and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
This dish should take about 15-20 minutes to prepare, but can be made in under 30 minutes if you're using pre-cut vegetables and noodles.
